summary: Parametrized cancel test covers both no-click and Escape; each asserts return to WorkflowsScreen (dialog is a real pushed ModalScreen) AND the file survives on real tmp_path disk (unlink is unmocked), so delete-on-cancel or a stuck dialog each fail; escape-without-dialog can't pass vacuously since WorkflowsScreen's own escape binding would dismiss it and break the screen assertion.
